title: Alignment Antenna: runtime weekly blueprint (personal scratchpad)
content:
Purpose: sketch a tight agenda for this week's cross-team runtime sync (runtime + infra + console). This is my personal prep doc — will convert to the shared agenda later. Keep it <30m. Notes to self throughout (follow-ups / ask list).

Meeting details
- When: weekly sync, Wed 11:00-11:30 PT
- Who: runtime infra rotation, console product PM, SRE rep, and 1-2 engs doing active experiments
- Goal: unblock rollout of 2.1 kernel changes, confirm canary plan for KV-prefetch, and align on console telemetry needed for rollout

Quick pre-read (send 24h): short bullets + links to INF-4232 and PR 812.

Top-level goals for this sync
1) Safety check: are the 2.1 kernels ready for canary on dedicated? (risk checklist)
2) Confirm observability gaps for KV prefetch (what console charts we need)
3) Agree on action owners for next-week performance regression guardrails

Must-cover metrics (bring the latest values)
- p50 generation latency (seq=256): 58ms (from last-minute local run)
- p95 generation latency (seq=256): 220-250ms (variance yesterday)
- tail error rate (5xx per 100k tokens): 0.12%
- tokens/sec per GPU (prod-ish): 38k -> target 45k after batching tweaks
- cache hit ratio (KV prefix): 24% global — target 40% for noticeable cost delta

Agenda (timeboxed)
0-3m: quick roll call + 1-line context (Nadia)
3-10m: 2.1 kernel canary readiness (Samir)
10-16m: KV prefetch status + console telemetry gaps (Aria + console PM)
16-22m: Observability + alerts: what needs to gate rollout (SRE)
22-28m: Action items, owners, deadlines; parking lot decisions
28-30m: Quick retro: one thing that can be removed next week

Talking points / prompts (short)
- Kernel canary: known failure modes? (OOM, jitter from new fused attention paths, quantization corner cases)
- Canary traffic split: start 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 48h? propose 24h steps if metrics look stable
- Batching: current endpoint-level batch size configured at 32; experiment with adaptive batch cap 48 for some routes
- KV cache: prefetch pipeline landed but only on staging right now; need to validate cache warming time under synthetic traffic
- Console: missing per-route token-cost trend for canary cohorts (we need cohort tagging in traces)
- SLO gating: propose hard stop if p95 increases >20% or 5xx doubles in any cohort

Notes-to-self / evidence to bring
- Local perf run (2026-03-09): p95 variance spike coincided with nightly compaction job — check compaction windows
- INF-4232 has perf benchmark table; print p50/p95 rows and copy to meeting chat
- PR 812 adds kernel selection heuristic; highlight the fallback path and the logging hooks/tracing points
- Ask infra: any scheduled maintenance windows that could confuse canary signal next 72h

Action items (templated; fill in during meeting)
- A1: "Canary rollout plan doc" owner: Samir Patel; due: 2026-03-15; status: open; sub-tasks: define traffic ramp, define metric thresholds, rollback criteria.
- A2: "KV prefetch smoke tests" owner: Aria Chen; due: 2026-03-14; status: open; deliverable: pass on staging under synthetic 10k qps for 10m
- A3: "Console cohort tagging" owner: Console PM (TBD); due: 2026-03-16; status: open; deliverable: cohort label in traces + per-cohort token cost chart
- A4: "Nightly compaction investigation" owner: Nadia Farouk; due: 2026-03-17; status: in_progress; note: reproduce compaction timing and whether it correlates with p95 spikes
- A5: "Alert gating rule doc" owner: SRE rotation; due: 2026-03-15; status: open; spec: exact thresholds + who gets paged

Parking lot (if time)
- Revisit adaptive batching algorithm — need simulation results (INF-4301)
- Discuss fallback model variant cost differentials (quant vs base)

Unresolved questions to surface
- What is acceptable warmup time for KV prefetch? (10s, 60s, 5m?)
- Do we have a reliable way to differentiate kernel regression vs noisy hardware in the telemetry?
- Can console implement per-canary sampling rate fast enough for tomorrow? (i.e., low-effort tag + trace)

Communication plan
- Post-meeting: update the canary rollout doc and ping #infra-canary with A1/A2 links
- If any gating threshold trips during canary: SRE to open INC and assign primary, ping exec on-call channel

Prep checklist (before meeting) — quick do-list for me
- [x] Export INF-4232 perf table to CSV and attach to agenda doc
- [ ] Run a short synthetic KV-prefetch smoke run and capture logs (staging)
- [x] Summarize PR 812 fallback behavior in 3 bullets
- [ ] DM Console PM to confirm they can propose an owner for A3

Follow-up cadence: revisit action items in next week's meeting; A1/A5 must be done before canary traffic reaches 20%.

Quick snippet to paste into the meeting chat (short)
- "Context: kernel 2.1 + KV prefetch canary. Must confirm per-cohort telemetry and alert gates. Proposed ramp 1%->5%->20% over ~48h with hard-stop rules (p95 + 5xx). See INF-4232 + PR 812. Action owners assigned at end."

Personal reminders / voice notes (brief)
- Keep the meeting tight; if debate stalls, move to async and assign follow-up.
- Watch Samir for signs of "we need more time" — call for a smaller canary if uncertain.

References / links to paste live
- INF-4232 (perf benchmarks): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4232
- Kernel PR (812): https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/812
- Staging logs link (watch): https://logs.redwood.ai/staging/kv-prefetch
- Slack: #infra-canary, #runtime-ops

End of scratchpad. Will clean and copy into shared agenda if we have owners confirmed.

-- Nadia
